note: Hand-written statements about what was checked and what the figures do and do not mean. Only companies listed in 'release' are published. Written 2026-11-15 from docs/sec-filing-verification.md; update both together.

verification.scope: Fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025 (the comparative column) were compared with the printed Form 10-K: revenue, cost of sales, operating income, net income, total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capital expenditure and debt. Every compared figure matched.
verification.unverified: Fiscal years before 2025 come from the SEC's structured data and passed automatic checks only; they have not been compared with the printed filings.

limitations: Debt is term debt, current and non-current (78,114 million at 26 Sep 2026). It excludes commercial paper (1,997 million); with it the total would be 80,111 million.
Apple's fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of September and is sometimes 53 weeks; the weeks are shown under the year heading.
Net margin, return and growth figures are calculated by CreditScope from the reported amounts and are not Apple's own measures.

verification.scope: Fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025 (the comparative column) were compared with the filing's financial statements (read from the filing's rendered statement pages): revenue, cost of revenue, operating income, net income, total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capital expenditure and debt. Every compared figure matched.
verification.unverified: Fiscal years before 2025 come from the SEC's structured data and passed automatic checks only; they have not been compared with the printed filings.

limitations: Capital expenditure is cash paid for property and equipment (115,948 million in fiscal 2026). It excludes 24,608 million of assets obtained under finance leases (a non-cash item), so free cash flow does not deduct them.
Debt is the carrying amount of total debt including the current portion (40,294 million), not its face value (46,136 million).
Fiscal 2015 operating cash flow is Microsoft's 'from continuing operations' figure, because that year was reported under a different concept; later years are total operating cash flow.
Microsoft's fiscal year ends on 30 June, so fiscal 2026 ended in calendar 2026 and covers July 2025 to June 2026.
Margins, returns and growth rates are calculated by CreditScope from the reported amounts and are not Microsoft's own measures.
